claims.statement: Shared source geometry with explicit H/W/J propulsion, cockpit and mission modules is appropriate; variant resemblance still needs separate acceptance.
AC-130W is the selected specific H-derived gunship reference with two EO/IR sensors and30 mm/105 mm visual installations.
Chin sensor and lower port-belly sensor ahead of main sponson; relative location only.
Forward port installation aft of entry; aft station behind main sponson.
Two sensors established by factsheet; second-sensor exact placement in J model is provisional family transfer, not independently calibrated.
Disable/replace port aft-door module where gun station occupies same modeled area; retain starboard door. Exact real conversion details unresolved.
Lower ramp hinged at cargo-floor aft threshold; upper door raised inward beneath roof. Closed/open and alternate angles inspected.
Angles, translations and timing are authored; still images do not validate swept path.
Forward port crew door lowers outward/down into stairs; closed/source fit and hinges need model validation.
Aft side door is raised inside overhead in photographed J. Full track path and endpoints incomplete.
Principal main-gear motion vertical into side wells. Photos confirm architecture, original manual text corroborates; travel and linkage remain authored.
Nose gear folds forward; down endpoint photographed. No motion sequence inspected.
Separate inboard/intermediate flap region and outboard aileron. Actual Fowler track/angles not calibrated.
Different J propulsion and six swept blades; nacelle/intake is separate module. Exact shell resemblance still provisional.
W analogue flight-engineer panel versus J digital cockpit/HUD references. Functional avionics not in scope.
All control ranges, durations and presentation timing are authored game values; not operational data.
Retracted gear should be enclosed by closed covers. A visibly uncovered well is a model defect. Exact visual fit and authored linkage remain separate validation requirements.

gaps: Exact original source identity/license remains unresolved.
No calibrated station drawings or skin sections in inspected references.
No full motion video of ramp, gear, flap or personnel-door path inspected.
J second EO/IR station and nacelle/intake dimensions not independently calibrated.
Aileron/rudder/elevator control limits and all animation timing are authored.
Static photo comparisons do not establish collision clearance or native engine execution.
